title: Important Amendments Related to FR, DPSP, and FD

cells: Added reasonable restrictions to Freedom of Speech, introduced Ninth Schedule to protect land reform laws.
Further restricted Right to Property and strengthened land reform measures.
Gave primacy to Directive Principles over Fundamental Rights related to property.
Added Fundamental Duties, introduced new DPSPs such as Article 39A (free legal aid) and Article 48A (environment protection).
Removed Right to Property from Fundamental Rights and made it a legal right under Article 300A.
Made education a Fundamental Right (Article 21A) and modified DPSP to provide early childhood care.
Added provisions related to cooperative societies and democratic functioning.

blocks.content: The 42nd Amendment Act of 1976 is known as the Mini-Constitution due to its wide-ranging changes to the Indian Constitution.

rows: Gave precedence to all DPSPs over Fundamental Rights under Articles 14 and 19
Restored primacy of FRs; removed Right to Property (Art 31) from FR list
Added Articles 39(f), 39A, 43A, and 48A to Part IV
Added Article 38(2) emphasizing reduction of inequalities in income and status
Introduced Part IV-A and 10 Fundamental Duties (Art 51A)
Maintained Part IV-A without direct modifications

items: The 86th Amendment (2002) made simultaneous changes across Fundamental Rights (Art 21A), DPSPs (Art 45), and Fundamental Duties (Art 51A(k)).
Right to Property was removed from Part III (FR) and placed under Article 300A in Part XII as a legal right by the 44th Amendment Act, 1978.
Fundamental Duties were not in the original 1950 Constitution; they were incorporated by the 42nd Amendment (1976) based on Swaran Singh Committee recommendations.

blocks.title: Key Takeaways
items: The 42nd Constitutional Amendment Act (1976) introduced Part IV-A and Article 51A, adding 10 Fundamental Duties upon the recommendation of the Swaran Singh Committee.
The 44th Amendment Act (1978) deleted the Right to Property from Fundamental Rights (Article 31) and re-classified it as a legal right under Article 300A.
The 86th Amendment Act (2002) added Article 21A (Right to Education as FR), modified Article 45 (DPSP), and added the 11th Fundamental Duty under Article 51A(k).

The 42nd Amendment added four new DPSPs: Article 39 (healthy development of children), Article 39A (equal justice and free legal aid), Article 43A (worker participation in management), and Article 48A (protection of environment and wildlife).
